conditioning.name: Friday Outdoor Run-Walk — Before the Plan
conditioning.purpose: A short, easy outdoor outing before the main plan starts on Monday.

warmUp.name: Walking warm-up
warmUp.detail: Walk 500 m, gradually becoming brisker. Begin running only if walking is comfortable.

main.name: Easy run-walk
main.detail: 3 x 400 m easy running, each followed by 150 m walking, including after the final repetition. Conversational effort with no pace target.

conditioning.howToUse: Follow distances rather than the estimated clock timings. Keep this easy, particularly if you lifted this morning. Shorten running repetitions if breathing becomes hard. Stop if the previous calf, ankle or shin burning returns. No additional running over the weekend; the main plan starts Monday.
helpers: Flat, even outdoor route with reliable footing.
Running shoes and watch; visibility aids if needed.
